title: Research, Innovation & Knowledge
tagline: Advancing Evidence-Based Solutions for Disaster Risk Reduction and Resilient Development
introduction: The BRD Tanzania Research Center undertakes, promotes and supports applied research to generate scientific evidence, innovative approaches and practical knowledge that contribute to disaster risk reduction, climate change adaptation and resilient, sustainable development.
overview: Our research focuses on understanding disaster risks, assessing vulnerabilities, strengthening community resilience and identifying innovative solutions to address emerging and evolving environmental and development challenges.
areas: Disaster Risk Assessment and Disaster Risk Reduction
Geospatial Science, GIS and Earth Observation
Early Warning Systems and Disaster Preparedness
Social Vulnerability, Gender and Inclusive Resilience
Disaster Governance, Policy and Institutional Resilience
